title: The Elder Scrolls: Betrayal of the Second Era
subtitle: Epic open-world exploration, character building, and delve combat across the provinces of Tamriel
tagline: Forge your hero, thwart the Planemeld, and uncover the betrayal
loreSummary: Tamriel fractures under the weight of the Planemeld as the Order of the Black Worm seeks the Amulet of Kings. Amidst dark anchors and scheming factions, an even deeper treachery threatens to drag the mortal realm into Oblivion.
keyFeatures: Three-session modular adventures chaining into monumental provincial campaigns
Deep character building with expansive skill lines, classes, and racial traits
Dual-phase gameplay: overland wilderness exploration and tactical hex grid delves
Replayable guild questlines across Cyrodiil, Morrowind, High Rock, and Black Marsh

tes_single_adventure.name: Single Province Adventure (1 Region)
tes_single_adventure.description: A standalone 3-session story arc within a single province, culminating in a climactic regional delve.

tes_provincial_chronicle.name: Provincial Campaign Chronicle (3 Regions)
tes_provincial_chronicle.description: The recommended full campaign across 3 linked provinces, developing your character through 9 epic sessions to a grand finale.

tes_grand_tamriel.name: Grand Tamriel Odyssey (5 Regions)
tes_grand_tamriel.description: An expansive multi-regional saga traversing 5 provinces and facing escalating Planemeld catastrophes across 15 sessions.

tes_master_lorekeeper.name: Master Lorekeeper (All Provinces & Expansions)
tes_master_lorekeeper.description: The ultimate completionist journey through every base province and expansion region, completing major guild contracts over 24 sessions.
